caption: [Untitled painting gifted to Emily Dickinson] (c. 1882). Mabel Loomis Todd. Amherst College Archives & Special Collections.
alt: A small painting on a black panel with a gilt edge: a clump of ghostly white Indian pipe plants rising from a tuft of dark grass, their stems bending over into nodding bell-shaped flowers, one turned to show a yellow centre.
title: [Indian pipes]
bibliography: Todd, Mabel Loomis. [Painting of Indian pipes, given to Emily Dickinson]. 1882, Amherst College Archives & Special Collections, Amherst, Massachusetts.
